name: Convert brainmask from dtiinit
summary: Utility that copies the brain mask from a vistasoft dtiInit output (dti/bin/brainMask.nii.gz) into a mask datatype.
description: Copies dtiInit's DWI brain mask to mask/mask.nii.gz so it can be used by Apps that take a mask input. Temporary converter until dtiInit outputs a mask datatype directly. Needs a dtiInit output.

inputs.description: Top directory of a dtiInit output; must contain dti/bin/brainMask.nii.gz.

outputs.description: Brain mask of the DWI from the dtiInit output (mask.nii.gz).
